name: @neuropause/integrations
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Integration & Live Provider Platform (NCEA 13.0) — production-capable adapters implementing the existing AiProvider + Connector SDK interfaces: AI providers, SaaS/OAuth connectors, database/storage connectors, sync engine, webhook framework, reliability (backoff/circuit-breaker), and observability.
